claims.description: Block flow and supported inline display aliases produce deterministic layout boxes.

notes.text: Authored inline values reach shared inline formatting for non-replaced text containers. Computed blockification applies to absolute/fixed elements and flex/grid items, including display:contents flattening. inline-block and list-item remain blockified; flow-root reaches the backend formatting context.
Atomic inline replaced elements, inline-block formatting, and list marker layout are not modeled.

claims.description: Flex and grid display values select the corresponding layout model.

notes.text: `inline-flex` and `inline-grid` are mapped to `flex` and `grid`; their inline-level outer display behavior is not modeled.

claims.description: Box suppression and child flattening follow supported display semantics.

notes.text: `display: contents` has parity coverage for parent box removal plus block and flex child flattening.
Inline `display: none !important` suppresses the element and descendants in geometry and hit testing; important inline declarations take precedence over later normal inline declarations.
